title: USB From Locker
scenario: You find a USB stick near your locker labelled 'answers'.

answers.A: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.B: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: USB From Locker: the trap is to turn convenience into a device or network security risk. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Unknown USB drives can infect devices.
